function.name: summarize_chat
function.description: Load recent messages from a WhatsApp chat this bot has logged, then return a transcript plus a compact fact sheet. Use after list_chats when the owner asks to summarize a group or DM, recap what people said, or extract facts, decisions, names, dates, and action items. Match by chat name or jid.

chat.description: Chat name, jid, or search text from list_chats, for example Family Group or 120363...@g.us

limit.description: How many recent messages to include, 10 to 200. Default 80.

focus.description: Optional topic to highlight, for example meeting time, money, or who is traveling
